content.short: DexStar is a fully permissioned DeFi debt marketplace providing capital markets infrastructure for sustainable businesses.
content.description: DexStar operates as a fully permissioned debt marketplace, bringing DeFi efficiency into traditional finance. As a DeFi protocol, it provides capital markets infrastructure for sustainable businesses and connects a growing DeFi capital base with the funding needs of these enterprises. By aligning DeFi liquidity with real‑world financing, DexStar aims to streamline access to debt for sustainable borrowers while offering a transparent, compliant platform for lenders and issuers alike.
content.meta: DexStar is a permissioned debt marketplace that brings DeFi efficiency to TradFi. Discover DexStar and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
